town_description: Thoubal is a town and district headquarters in the Manipur valley, about 22 km south of Imphal on NH-102 (Imphal-Moreh road). It sits beside the Thoubal River in a rice-growing plain, with the historic Khongjom War Memorial (1891 Anglo-Manipuri War) nearby. The town is predominantly Meitei and has several small Hindu temples and Sanamahi shrines.
